capabilities.environment: Autonomous coding agent with file and shell access; output must run offline from file:// in current desktop Chrome, Firefox, Safari, or Edge.
constraints: Single self-contained index.html plus README.md; no build step, framework, or external asset.

budget.notes: A bounded one-brief game build; internal testing and repairs are expected.

artifacts.description: Controls, rules, architecture, and honest verification record.

one_shot_policy.notes: One initial brief; the executor may test and repair within the same autonomous run.

title: Signal Siege — keyboard tower defence
summary: Can an agent ship a deterministic tower-defence loop with keyboard-only placement, distinct tactical roles, and a bounded set of defensible waves?
benchmark_question: Can an agent ship a deterministic tower-defence loop with keyboard-only placement, distinct tactical roles, and a bounded set of defensible waves?

verification.description: The single HTML opens from file:// without console errors, external URLs, or network-capable runtime calls.
Keyboard-only controls select towers, place on pads, upgrade, start waves, and reset an ended game.
Five fixed waves and tower values are documented; the read-only snapshot agrees with visible build and active-wave states.
A rendered play view visibly distinguishes path, enemies, selected build pad, tower ranges or attacks, and HUD.
